howto: Pick a level on the title: 3 letters up to 9+ letters. Harder levels unlock as you earn XP.
Tap the letter tiles in order to spell the hidden word. Tap a filled slot to send a letter back.
Finish each word before the time bar runs out. Three misses or time-outs end the game.
tips: Look for common endings like -ING, -ER and -LE first.
A word with no hints and no mistakes scores a PERFECT +5.
Your streak adds up to +30 points a word, so a skip costs more than it looks.
Shuffle the tiles when you are stuck: a new order often shows the word.
Gold tiles count towards your gold collection on the title screen.

controls.keyboard: Type letters to place tiles, Backspace takes the last one back. Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap tiles to place them, tap a slot to send its letter back

difficulty: Five level bands by word length: 3 letters (ages 5-6), 4-5 (6-7), 6 (7-8), 7-8 (8-9) and 9+ (9 and up). Each band unlocks with XP and gives more time for longer words.

features.age-or-level-bands: Five word-length levels on the title, with an age guide in the grown-ups report
features.hints: In-game Hint button places the next letter; the arcade Hint names the next letter or the wrong slot
features.grown-up-progress-report: Grown-ups button on the title: words tried and accuracy per level, practice days, the words missed most and a suggested next level
features.tutorial: Guided first word with coach cards (the timer waits); replay with Learn to play
features.results: Game Over card with score, best, best streak and fastest word
